name: Polyglot Language Switcher
effect: The altered model starts a reply in English for a word or two, then switches into another language for the rest of it, usually Portuguese or Indonesian and sometimes Italian, Russian, Spanish, German, French or Chinese. It often mixes sever
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
